strong_retest.rule: PASS iff, on the retest sample only: score(greedy) > .500 + SE(greedy) and score(categorical) > .386 + SE(categorical), score = (W + D/2)/n over both seats (n = 176 per mode), SE = sd(per-game score)/sqrt(n); and net wins (W-L) and deliveries, each summed over both seats and both modes, >= those of G_frozen self-play on the same retest seeds. Reference .500/.386 = G_frozen two-seat self-play of cc_strong_eval_v1 (greedy self-play is .500 by symmetry). Seed-clustered SE is reported as a supplement only; merged (original + retest) scores and SE are reported, not used for the verdict.
